title: Playground sprint handoff and SDK sandboxes — Oct 01 2026
content:
Meeting: DevExp playground + SDK sandboxes sprint handoff
Date: 2026-10-01
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya Chen, Leo Park, Sofia Martinez, Ethan Ross, Anika Rao (partial)

TL;DR:
- Last sprint focused on stabilizing the SDK playground environment and creating three canonical quickstart samples (Python sync, TypeScript streaming, and Embeddings batch).
- All critical build failures resolved; one flaky integration test (ts-stream-conn) remains and is quarantined behind feature-flag.
- Ready to hand off to Catalog & Docs for final copy and screenshots; Playground team will keep guardrails enabled for one more week in prod-staging.
- Action items assigned (see below).

Goals for this handoff meeting:
1) Align on which samples move to official quickstart gallery.
2) Confirm rollout steps for new SDK patch (v0.18.2) and playground infra changes.
3) Surface remaining risks and owners for post-handoff monitoring.

Key outcomes / Decisions:
- Samples selected for gallery: python-sync-basic, ts-streaming-chat, embeddings-batch-mapper. (These three will be promoted to docs/quickstarts.)
- SDK release v0.18.2 will include: improved reconnect logic, smaller bundle for TS, new example metadata schema for embedding jobs. Cut on 2026-10-04 (release window 09:00–10:30 PT).
- Playground prod-staging settings: throttling reduced to simulate low-latency tier; KV cache warmup enabled for first 24 hours after deploy.
- Quarantine policy: any test flakiness bumped to JIRA subtask and flagged with [quarantine].

Demos / Highlights:
- Leo walked through the new “sample metadata” UI for the quickstart gallery — shows expected token costs and sample runtime (mocked via metrics). It already surfaced an incorrect estimate on embeddings-batch-mapper; fix noted in JIRA-DEVEXP-715.
- Sofia demoed the TS streaming sample running in the playground with the new streaming chunk size heuristic — latency improved ~14% on short prompts in staging.
- Ethan ran a smoke test suite (50 scenarios) showing 98% pass; failures are concentrated around intermittent websocket connect drops (ts-stream-conn).

Open Blockers / Risks:
- ts-stream-conn flaky integration test (JIRA-DEVEXP-718) — blocks promotion of streaming sample to main branch until root cause understood. Workaround: feature-flag streaming sample in gallery and surface fallback to polling SDK example. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2026-10-05.
- Metrics discrepancy: cost estimates in sample metadata are conservative but mismatch billing simulation by ~8%. Need to reconcile kernel selection assumptions with the catalog model profile. Owner: Leo + ModelOps. ETA: 2026-10-07.
- Docs screenshots: a couple of UI changes landed after screenshots were taken; docs team asked for a 'stable screenshot' job in CI. Owner: Sofia to coordinate with Docs. ETA: 2026-10-04.

Notes on engineering changes in this sprint:
- SDK: Added reconnect/backoff rewrite (PR #924). The change keeps the retry budget per connection and avoids exponential retries on permanent 4xx errors. This reduces noisy logs seen in staging.
- Playground infra: Reduced default batching window from 25ms -> 12ms for dev boxes. Added a small in-memory KV cache warmup for recently used prefixes. Temp flag: play-caching=true
- Samples: Introduced metadata.yaml in each sample repo with fields: title, description, expected_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, required_env (list), quick-run-command. We intentionally keep schema lightweight to make automation easier.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ethan Ross — root cause analysis for ts-stream-conn + patch or long-term mitigation; mark progress on JIRA-DEVEXP-718 — due 2026-10-05.
- Leo Park — reconcile sample cost estimator with catalog profiles and publish adjustment rules; update JIRA-DEVEXP-715 — due 2026-10-07.
- Sofia Martinez — create CI job for 'stable screenshots' and add to quickstart validation; coordinate with docs team for new gallery screenshots — due 2026-10-04.
- Maya Chen — cut release notes draft for v0.18.2 and coordinate release window with Platform Eng; prepare rollback checklist — due 2026-10-03.
- Docs (assigned to Anika Rao) — copy edit quickstart drafts, capture screenshots from prod-staging after deploy, and confirm code snippets compile in the sandbox — due 2026-10-06.
- Support (FYI) — add a monitoring runbook for the playground feature flags for 72 hours after release — owner: SRE rotation — due 2026-10-05.

Quality checks performed this sprint:
- Smoke suite (50 scenarios) across Python and TS samples; 98% pass.
- Basic accessibility audit on quickstart pages (contrast, headings) — minor fixes logged under JIRA-DEVEXP-721.
- Token estimator test harness executed on sample inputs (100 inputs) and baseline recorded for future regression checks.

Rollout plan (brief):
1) Merge release branch after last green (expect 2026-10-03 morning).
2) Deploy v0.18.2 to playground prod-staging; run post-deploy sanity (smoke suite + sample run).
3) Docs team captures screenshots and finalizes quickstart copy.
4) If smoke passes and no new critical flakes, promote selected samples to gallery and update quickstart index.
5) Monitor for 72 hours; if token estimator discrepancy >10% rollback or feature-flag sample.

Parking lot / future ideas (not for this sprint):
- Add per-sample telemetry to understand which quickstarts users run most and surface to marketing.
- Auto-generate sample thumbnails from recorded runs to keep gallery fresh.
- Explore a lightweight WASM runner for client-side quickstarts to reduce infra cost for demos.

Appendix (useful refs):
- Smoke run results: attached as artifact in JIRA-DEVEXP-719 (linked_artifacts above).
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/924 (reconnect/backoff)
- Playground setup doc: confluence:devexp-playground-setup

Next handoff check-in:
- 2026-10-06 10:00 PT (15 min) — brief status, confirm ownership on lingering items.

Notes to future reader:
If you pick this up after 2026-10-08, check JIRA-DEVEXP-718 and -715 first; they will capture the majority of follow-ups. The playground flags are labelled with 'play-' prefix in infra and can be toggled from the Console -> Dev Tools page.

End of notes.
